subject: Re: Re: reserve on my account - still no real answer
body: I spoke to someone from your team on call about this last week and they said someone would follow up with the exact release schedule for the reserve amount, but I still haven't received anything in writing. As I mentioned before, this reserve is a big problem for our cash flow going into the festive season bookings. Can I please get a straight answer this time - what is the exact date and amount of the next release, and is there any way to get this reviewed early given it's been a month since the chargebacks happened?
